---
title: "Analyzing US Census Data"
author: "GitHub Copilot"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  variables = "B19013_001",
  geometry = TRUE,
  output = "wide"
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
income_tx |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = B19013_001E)) +
  geom_sf(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis",
    name = "Median household income (2020 dollars)",
    guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by Texas County",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2016-2020 ACS 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  year = 2020,
  variables = c(
    "B15003_022",
    "B15003_023",
    "B15003_024",
    "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  output = "wide"
)
```

```{r}
edu_state |>
  mutate(
    bachelors_or_higher = B15003_022E + B15003_023E + B15003_024E + B15003_025E,
    pct_bachelors = bachelors_or_higher / summary_est * 100
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(pct_bachelors)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(NAME, pct_bachelors), y = pct_bachelors)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Adult Education Attainment by State",
    subtitle = "Percent of adults with at least a bachelor’s degree",
    x = "State",
    y = "Percent of adults with a bachelor’s degree or higher",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2016-2020 ACS 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5)
  )
```
